name: Rate-Distortion Optimized RAHT
definition: A standard-compatible, rate-distortion optimized quantization framework for G-PCC RAHT that introduces configurable precision extension to reduce numerical errors and derives a rate-distortion model to allocate bits according to the hierarchical contribution of RAHT layers.
summary: Rate-Distortion Optimized RAHT is a G-PCC quantization framework that optimizes bit allocation for high-dynamic-range attributes using configurable fixed-point precision and an analytical rate-distortion model.
